leads.title: Caribbean Territories (Criminal Law) Order, 2000
leads.documents: Decriminalization of consensual same-sex sexual activity in private in British Virgin Islands since 2001; retains offences for group sex and sex in public / gross indecency
leads.detail: Cited as Order in Council by British Government pursuant to Sections 3(1) and 3(7); Section 4 retrospective effect; no URL visible in provided text

leads.title: British Virgin Islands Criminal Code - buggery provisions
leads.documents: Pre-2001 criminalisation of anal sex and oral sex as 'buggery' for heterosexuals and male homosexuals; lesbian activity never illegal; age of consent 16 regardless of gender/orientation
leads.detail: Cited as 'British Virgin Islands Criminal Code'; no URL visible in provided text

leads.title: European Convention on Human Rights
leads.documents: International human rights obligations requiring BVI Government to ensure non-discrimination and equality; recognised by courts as having legal effect in jurisdiction
leads.detail: Cited as adherence obligation as British Overseas Territory; no URL visible in provided text

leads.title: Virgin Islands Constitution Order 2007 - Constitution
leads.documents: Constitutional prohibition of discrimination on basis of sexual orientation; definition of 'Discriminatory' treatment
leads.detail: Quoted preamble and definition including 'sexual orientation'; cited as 2007 Constitution; no URL visible in provided text

leads.title: Marriage (Amendment) Act 2017
leads.documents: Absence of provision for same-sex marriages or civil unions; House of Assembly debate with hostility to same-sex marriage and LGBTQ people
leads.detail: Cited as Marriage (Amendment) Act 2017 with 2015 Premier Orlando Smith consultation comments; no URL visible in provided text

leads.title: 2021 judicial review - local same-sex couple marriage recognition case
leads.documents: Constitutionality challenge to refusal to recognise same-sex marriage celebrated in United Kingdom; stayed pending Privy Council appeals but evidentiary proceedings continued July 2022 as government defended statutory ban
leads.detail: Cited as 2021 filing, July 2022 evidentiary proceedings; no case name or URL visible in provided text

leads.title: Court of Appeal ruling 2021 on same-sex marriage
leads.documents: Holding that same-sex marriage in BVI can be introduced only through legislative body and not through courts
leads.detail: Cited as Court of Appeal 2021 ruling; no case name or URL visible in provided text

leads.title: Privy Council appeals in Bermuda and Cayman Islands same-sex marriage cases
leads.documents: Precedent cases causing stay of BVI 2021 judicial review; rights machinery for same-sex union recognition in Overseas Territories
leads.detail: Cited as two pending Privy Council appeals involving Bermuda and Cayman Islands; no case names or URLs visible in provided text

leads.title: Constitutional Review Commission report 2024
leads.documents: Government-commissioned report recommending ban on same-sex marriage in the Virgin Islands
leads.detail: Cited as 2024 Constitutional Review Commission's report; no URL visible in provided text

leads.title: His Majesty's Government position on Order in Council / Premier statements on reform
leads.documents: UK confirmation it will not impose same-sex marriage recognition by Order in Council; Premier Natalio Wheatley Dec 2022 referendum proposal and June 2026 civil partnership intention
